convert_univnet_checkpoint: convert a UnivNet checkpoint to HuggingFace Transformers format and save to a local folder
run_convert_univnet_cli: run the UnivNet checkpoint conversion CLI with checkpoint path and output folder arguments
get_kernel_predictor_key_mapping: get a key mapping for kernel predictor weight names between old and new model architectures
get_key_mapping: get a full key mapping for renaming UnivNet state dict keys to HuggingFace model format
rename_state_dict: rename and filter state dict keys by applying a modification mapping and removing unwanted keys
